name: clear-mcp
description: Read CLEAR's humanitarian data — signals, events, alerts, crises, situation analyses and the knowledge base — from Claude.
long_description: A read-only connector to CLEAR (Crisis Learning, Early-warning, Anticipation, and Response). It forwards your CLEAR API key to clear-api and holds no data or credentials of its own, so every answer is bounded by exactly your CLEAR permissions. Start by asking "Who am I in CLEAR?", then "What's happened in North Darfur this month?".
